mentions.name: Babel Nexus
mentions.description: Babel Nexus is a web app that offers free ebook applications, including a "Beyond the Public Domain" section that recently gained several new free ebook apps. After billing issues with its previous hosting, it is being rebuilt on the author's home computer using PowerShell and VS Code, with plans to host it long-term on Railway; the currently live site is a placeholder.
mentions.source_excerpt: I continue working on my side project Babel Nexus.
mentions.author: NishanStepak
